name: Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair
review:
Beat the Beast: Kraken's Lair is an underwater 9-line slot with expanding wins and a bonus of free spins with retriggers.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 7,777x cap and a 96.12% RTP. A compact, sharp-edged entry in the series.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
